Politics · India

Supreme Court advises listening to youth, government unveils NEET reforms

The Supreme Court advised authorities to listen to and counsel protesting youth, stating reasoning is the most powerful tool to prevent violence. Chief Justice of India Surya Kant suggested authorities should deal with situations by pacifying and reasoning with demonstrators. The court also noted that stone-pelting cannot be justified. Separately, the government announced reforms for the NEET exam, including a 10-stage security protocol, AI, and blockchain technology, following paper leaks.
